title: Deploy pfSense firewall and network foundation
goal: Separate networks with a default-deny firewall between them.
built: The pfSense firewall, the first security boundary
Routing, DHCP and separate VLANs for infrastructure, clients and management
validated: I fixed two problems: VLANs that did not connect, and firewall rules that only took effect after a reboot. The cause of the second is not proven.
